  if e.message:findi("boots") then
    e.self:Say("Three crushed jaundice gems combined with torn enchanted silk boots would make a most interesting set of footwear. The latent powers of the gems can be harnessed to create magical effects.")

    e.other:Faction(430, -20, 0)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24924, item2 = 25829, item3 = 25829, item4 = 25829 }) then -- Summoner's Boots
    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(25425)
    e.other:AddEXP(150000)
    e.other:Faction(429, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(419, 20, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -20, 0)
  end
  -- Return every unconsumed item and coin, including on successful offers.
  item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
